CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

8. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

9. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Photography.

10. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   C. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.

12. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
